notes: Converted from MAME's src/mame/cinematronics/nl_armora.cpp (NETLIST_START(armora), CC0-1.0, Aaron Giles) at mame0289 by tools/mame_netlist.py. Every change from MAME's file -- the simulation stand-ins undone, the hacks dropped, the corrections from the sheet -- is logged at the top of boards/armora-sound.nets.

MAME's file says 'Entire schematic needs a verification pass'. With HLE_TANK_VCO off the tread VCO is MAME's own description of the board's circuit; it uses Q1, which MAME declares only in a comment ('not used' -- by the stand-in), so the declaration is restored.

Compared with the audio board sheets 1-3, 72-11141-02 rev A (doc 94be099bc6ca pp84-86, native 300 dpi), the assembly drawing 72-11141-01 (p87) and the parts list 38-11141-01 (pp57-59), 2026-10-20: the input buffers IC1 and IC27, the shift register IC2 and latch IC3 (OUT 0+ to OUT 7+ on J2-11 to J2-16, MAME's port names), the tank motor (IC6 with R2, R3, C11, C12; IC8 loaded from TS0+-TS3+; IC9, IC10, IC11; R6, R7, C13, C14), the tread squeak (IC13, the 7406 IC7, the low-leakage switches Q14-Q19 and R95-R109 on sheet 2, R14-R23, C18, C19) with the 566 VCO IC15 (R11, C15-C17) and the converter Q1, R4, R12, R13, D5, D8 exactly as MAME's HLE_TANK_VCO-off branch has them, the noise source (IC17, C20, C21, R26, IC18), all five envelope switches and CA3080 channels (Q2-Q11, R27-R83, R94, C22-C34, IC19-IC22), the beep 555 IC23 (R81-R83, C35-C37) and the summing follower IC25 with C43, R91 and the SJ amplifier IC26 (R90, R92) all agree with MAME pin for pin and value for value, transistor and diode orientation included. The parts list agrees with every IC, transistor (Q1 is a 2N3904), diode and capacitor; C28, which MAME's file could not place, is one of six 0.1uF bypass capacitors on -15V. Nothing needed correcting.
Not in this file: the final amplifier (IC24, Q12, Q13, R24, R25, R84-R89, C38-C42, the volume pot R93) and the regulators IC4/IC5, which are on sheets 1 and 3 with the values MAME's comments give.
conflicts: The parts list gives 111 resistors where both drawings place 109: it carries an 82K and a second 910K that neither the sheets nor the assembly drawing have (R82 is 8.2K on both; at 82K IC23 would not oscillate). Its 2.7K and 4.7K counts (13 and 8) are also swapped against both drawings (8 and 13). This file follows the drawings.
